# AssistSec

> AI-assisted penetration testing from the Netherlands, serving Europe:
> autonomous agents surface security findings continuously, and senior
> pentesters (OSCP/OSWE certified) validate every finding before it reaches
> the customer. The platform behind it is called ARGUS.

AssistSec combines autonomous security-testing agents with human expert
validation. Customers get continuous coverage of web applications and APIs
instead of a yearly audit, with findings mapped to compliance frameworks such
as ISO 27001. The site is available in English (https://assistsec.nl) and
Dutch (https://assistsec.nl/nl).

## Services

- [Web application pentesting](https://assistsec.nl/services/web-app-pentesting):
  manual and agent-assisted testing of web applications.
- [API pentesting](https://assistsec.nl/services/api-pentesting): testing of
  REST and other API surfaces.
- [Security awareness](https://assistsec.nl/services/security-awareness):
  training for teams.
